name: University of Paris emerges
summary: Around 1170 the masters teaching in the schools attached to the cathedral of Notre-Dame in Paris organise themselves into a self-governing universitas. Royal protection (1200) and the statutes of Robert of Courson (1215) formalise the corporation.

_quarry.structural_significance: Master-governed model that becomes the European norm for theology and the liberal arts. Aquinas, Albertus Magnus, Bonaventure, Duns Scotus, and Ockham all teach or study here.
